(std::abs(det) < EPSILON) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n427: \n428:     val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;\n429:     Vec3 tvec = orig - v0;\n430:     val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;\n431:     if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n432: \n433:     Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);\n434:     val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n435:     if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n436: \n437:     return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n438: }\n439: \n440: // ============================================================================\n441: // Visibility Testing (Octree-accelerated)\n442: // ============================================================================\n443: \n444: // Check if a ray between two triangles is blocked by any other triangle\n445: // Uses octree for O(log N) instead of O(N) search\n446: bool isRayBlocked(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,\n447:                   const Octree& octree,\n448: \n454:     return octree.applyToTris(from, to, [&](size_t idx, const Triangle& tri) {\n455:         if (idx == srcTriIdx || idx == dstTriIdx) return false;\n456: \n457:         val_t dist = rayTriangleIntersect(from, dirNorm, tri.a, tri.b, tri.c);\n458:         if (dist > EPSILON && dist < rayLen - EPSILON) {\n459:             return true;  // Ray is blocked\n460:         }\n461: ============================================================================\n468: \n469: // Compute the cosine of angle between vector and triangle normal\n470: val_t cosPhi(const Vec3& v, const Vec3& normal) {\n471:     val_t vNorm = v.norm();\n472:     if (vNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;\n473:     return std::max(ZERO, v.dot(normal) / vNorm);\n474: }\n475: \n476: // Compute form factor Kij between triangle i (receiver) and triangle j (emitter)\n477: val_t computeKij(size_t idxI, size_t idxJ,\n478:                   const std::vector<Triangle>& triangles,\n479:                   const Octree& octree,\n480:                   RandomGenerator& rng) {\n481:     const Triangle& triI = triangles[idxI];\n482:     const Triangle& triJ = triangles[idxJ];\n483: \n484:     // Cull triangles facing the same direction\n485:     if (triI.normal().dot(triJ.normal()) > 0.99f) return ZERO;\n486: \n487:     val_t kij = ZERO;\n488: \n489:     for (int r = 0; r < NUM_RAYS; ++r) {\n490:         Vec3 pI = randomPointInTriangle(triI, rng);\n491:         Vec3 pJ = randomPointInTriangle(triJ, rng);\n492: \n493:         if (isRayBlocked(pI, pJ, octree, idxI, idxJ)) continue;\n494: \n495:         Vec3 v = pJ - pI;\n496:         val_t distSqr = v.squaredNorm();\n497:         if (distSqr < EPSILON) continue;\n498: \n499:         val_t cosPhiI = cosPhi(v, triI.normal());\n500:         val_t cosPhiJ = cosPhi(-v, triJ.normal());\n501: \n502:         if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;\n503: \n504:         kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distSqr);\n505:     }\n506: \n507: Vec3 {\n    val_t x, y, z;\n\n    constexpr Vec3() : x(0), y(0), z(0) {}\n    constexpr Vec3(val_t x, val_t y, val_t z) : x(x), y(y), z(z) {}\n    explicit constexpr Vec3(val_t v) : x(v), y(v), z(v) const { return {x * s, y * s, z * s}; }\n    Vec3 operator/(val_t s) const { return {x / s, y / s, z / s}; }\n    Vec3 operator-() const { return {-x, -y, -z}; }\n\n    val_t dot(const Vec3& o) const { return x * o.x + y * o.y + z * o.z; }\n    Vec3 cross(const Vec3& o) const {\n        return {y * o.z - z * o.y, z * o.x - x * o.z, x * o.y - y * o.x};\n    }\n\n    val_t squaredNorm() const { ============================================================================\n// Triangle-Box Overlap Test (for octree construction)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Separating axis test for triangle-box overlap\nbool triangleBoxOverlap(const Vec3& boxCenter, const Vec3& boxHalfSize, const Triangle& tri) {\n    // Translate triangle to box center\n    Vec3 v0 = tri.a - boxCenter;\n    Vec3 v1 = tri.b - boxCenter;\n    Vec3 v2 = tri.c - boxCenter;\n\n    // Triangle edges\n    Vec3 e0 = v1 - v0;\n    Vec3 e1 = v2 - v1;\n    Vec3 e2 = v0 - v2;\n\n    // Test box normals (AABB axes)\n    auto minMax3 = [](val_t a, val_t b, val_t c) {\n        return std::make_pair(std::min({a, b, c}), std::max({a, b, c}));\n    };\n\n    auto [minX, maxX] = minMax3(v0.x, v1.x, v2.x);\n    if (minX > boxHalfSize.x || maxX < -boxHalfSize.x) return false;\n\n    auto [minY, maxY] = minMax3(v0.y, v1.y, v2.y);\n    if (minY > boxHalfSize.y || maxY < -boxHalfSize.y) return false;\n\n    auto [minZ, maxZ] = minMax3(v0.z, v1.z, v2.z);\n    if (minZ > boxHalfSize.z || maxZ < -boxHalfSize.z) return false;\n\n    // Test triangle normal\n    Vec3 triNormal = e0.cross(e1);\n    val_t d = triNormal.dot(v0);\n    val_t r = boxHalfSize.x * std::abs(triNormal.x) +\n              boxHalfSize.y * std::abs(triNormal.y) +\n              boxHalfSize.z * std::abs(triNormal.z);\n    if (std::abs(d) > r) return false;\n\n    // Test 9 edge cross products\n    auto testAxis = [&](const Vec3& axis) {\n        val_t p0 = axis.dot(v0);\n        val_t p1 = axis.dot(v1);\n        val_t p2 = axis.dot(v2);\n        val_t r = boxHalfSize.x * std::abs(axis.x) +\n                  boxHalfSize.y * std::abs(axis.y) +\n                  boxHalfSize.z * std::abs(axis.z);\n        auto [minP, maxP] = minMax3(p0, p1, p2);\n        return !(minP > r || maxP < -r);\n    };\n\n    Vec3 axes[3] = {{1,0,0}, {0,1,0}, {0,0,1}};\n    Vec3 edges[3] = {e0, e1, e2};\n    for (const auto& axis : axes) {\n        for (const auto& edge : edges) {\n            Vec3 crossAxis = axis.cross(edge);\n            if (crossAxis.squaredNorm() > EPSILON) {\n                if (!testAxis(crossAxis)) return false;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Octree for Spatial Acceleration\n// ============================================================================\n\nconstexpr size_t MAX_OCTREE_TRIS = 8;\nconstexpr val_t MAX_OCTREE_LEAF_SIZE = 0.5f;\n\nclass Octree {\npublic:\n    Vec3 minBound, maxBound;\n    Vec3 halfExtent, center;\n    std::unique_ptr<Octree> children[8];\n    std::vector<size_t> triangleIndices;  // Indices into the global triangle list\n    const std::vector<Triangle>* allTriangles;  // Pointer to all triangles\n\n    Octree() : allTriangles(nullptr) {}\n\n    void build(const std::vector<Triangle>& triangles) {\n        allTriangles = &triangles;\n        if (triangles.empty()) return;\n\n        // Compute bounding box\n        minBound = triangles[0].a;\n        maxBound = triangles[0].a;\n        for (const auto& tri : triangles) {\n            for (const auto* v : {&tri.a, &tri.b, &tri.c}) {\n                minBound.x = std::min(minBound.x, v->x);\n                minBound.y = std::min(minBound.y, v->y);\n                minBound.z = std::min(minBound.z, v->z);\n                maxBound.x = std::max(maxBound.x, v->x);\n                maxBound.y = std::max(maxBound.y, v->y);\n                maxBound.z = std::max(maxBound.z, v->z);\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Collect all indices\n        std::vector<size_t> allIndices(triangles.size());\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < triangles.size(); ++i) allIndices[i] = i;\n\n        buildNode(allIndices, minBound, maxBound);\n    }\n\nprivate:\n    void buildNode(const std::vector<size_t>& indices, const Vec3& nodeMin, const Vec3& nodeMax) {\n        minBound = nodeMin;\n        maxBound = nodeMax;\n        halfExtent = (maxBound - minBound) * 0.5f;\n        center = (minBound + maxBound) * 0.5f;\n\n        // If few enough triangles or too small, make this a leaf\n        if (indices.size() <= MAX_OCTREE_TRIS ||\n            (maxBound - minBound).norm() < MAX_OCTREE_LEAF_SIZE) {\n            triangleIndices = indices;\n            return;\n        }\n\n        // Subdivide into 8 children\n        Vec3 childHalfSize = halfExtent * 0.5f;\n        std::vector<size_t> childIndices[8];\n\n        for (size_t idx : indices) {\n            const Triangle& tri = (*allTriangles)[idx];\n\n            // Check which children this triangle overlaps\n            for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n                Vec3 childCenter = center;\n                childCenter.x += (i & 1) ? childHalfSize.x : -childHalfSize.x;\n                childCenter.y += (i & 2) ? childHalfSize.y : -childHalfSize.y;\n                childCenter.z += (i & 4) ? childHalfSize.z : -childHalfSize.z;\n\n                if (triangleBoxOverlap(childCenter, childHalfSize, tri)) {\n                    childIndices[i].push_back(idx);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Check if we can't split further (all triangles in one child)\n        bool canSplit = false;\n        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n            if (!childIndices[i].empty() && childIndices[i].size() < indices.size()) {\n                canSplit = true;\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (!canSplit) {\n            triangleIndices = indices;\n            return;\n        }\n\n        // Build children\n        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n            if (!childIndices[i].empty()) {\n                Vec3 childMin = center;\n                Vec3 childMax = center;\n                childMin.x = (i & 1) ? center.x : minBound.x;\n                childMax.x = (i & 1) ? maxBound.x : center.x;\n                childMin.y = (i & 2) ? center.y : minBound.y;\n                childMax.y = (i & 2) ? maxBound.y : center.y;\n                childMin.z = (i & 4) ? center.z : minBound.z;\n                childMax.z = (i & 4) ? maxBound.z : center.z;\n\n                children[i] = std::make_unique<Octree>();\n                children[i]->allTriangles = allTriangles;\n                children[i]->buildNode(childIndices[i], childMin, childMax);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\npublic:\n    // Check if a ray intersects this node's bounding box\n    bool rayIntersectsBox(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2) const {\n        Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;\n        Vec3 c = p1 + d - center;\n        Vec3 ad = {std::abs(d.x), std::abs(d.y), std::abs(d.z)};\n\n        if (std::abs(c.x) > halfExtent.x + ad.x) return false;\n        if (std::abs(c.y) > halfExtent.y + ad.y) return false;\n        if (std::abs(c.z) > halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;\n\n        if (std::abs(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) > halfExtent.y * ad.z + halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;\n        if (std::abs(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) > halfExtent.z * ad.x + halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;\n        if (std::abs(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) > halfExtent.x * ad.y + halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;\n\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    // Apply a function to all triangles potentially intersecting the ray\n    // Returns true if the function returns true for any triangle\n    template<typename Func>\n    bool applyToTris(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2, Func&& func) const {\n        // If leaf node, check triangles directly\n      }\n\n        // Otherwise, descend to children\n        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n            if (children[i] && children[i]->rayIntersectsBox(p1, p2)) {\n                if (children[i]->applyToTris(p1, p2, func)) return true;\n            }\n        }\n        return false;\n    }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Mesh Generation: Icosphere\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Generate an icosphere by subdividing an icosahedron\nclass IcosphereMesh {\npublic:\n    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n\n    IcosphereMesh(int subdivisions, val_t radius) {\n        // Initial icosahedron vertices\n        const val_t t = (1.0f + std::sqrt(5.0f)) / 2.0f;\n\n        std::vector<Vec3> vertices = {\n            Vec3(-1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0, -1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0,  1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0, -1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0,  1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius\n        };\n\n        // Initial icosahedron faces (20 triangles)\n        std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> faces = {\n            {0, 11, 5}, {0, 5, 1}, {0, 1, 7}, {0, 7, 10}, {0, 10, 11},\n            {1, 5, 9}, {5, 11, 4}, {11, 10, 2}, {10, 7, 6}, {7, 1, 8},\n            {3, 9, 4}, {3, 4, 2}, {3, 2, 6}, {3, 6, 8}, {3, 8, 9},\n            {4, 9, 5}, {2, 4, 11}, {6, 2, 10}, {8, 6, 7}, {9, 8, 1}\n        };\n\n        // Subdivide\n        for (int i = 0; i < subdivisions; ++i) {\n            std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> newFaces;\n            std::map<std::pair<idx_t, idx_t>, idx_t> midpointCache;\n\n            auto getMidpoint = [&](idx_t i1, idx_t i2) -> idx_t {\n                auto key = std::make_pair(std::min(i1, i2), std::max(i1, i2));\n                auto it = midpointCache.find(key);\n                if (it != midpointCache.end()) return it->second;\n\n                Vec3 mid = (vertices[i1] + vertices[i2]) / 2.0f;\n                mid = mid.normalized() * radius;\n                idx_t idx = static_cast<idx_t>(vertices.size());\n                vertices.push_back(mid);\n                midpointCache[key] = idx;\n                return idx;\n            };\n\n            for (const auto& face : faces) {\n                idx_t a = getMidpoint(face[0], face[1]);\n                idx_t b = getMidpoint(face[1], face[2]);\n                idx_t c = getMidpoint(face[2], face[0]);\n\n                newFaces.push_back({face[0], a, c});\n                newFaces.push_back({face[1], b, a});\n                newFaces.push_back({face[2], c, b});\n                newFaces.push_back({a, b, c});\n            }\n            faces = std::move(newFaces);\n        }\n\n        // Build triangles (normals pointing inward for a \"room\")\n        triangles.reserve(faces.size());\n        for (const auto& face : faces) {\n            // Reverse winding to make normals point inward\n            triangles.emplace_back(vertices[face[2]], vertices[face[1]], vertices[face[0]]);\n        }\n    }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Random Number Generation\n// ============================================================================\n\nclass RandomGenerator {\n    std::mt19937 rng;\n    std::uniform_real_distribution<val_t> dist;\npublic:\n    explicit RandomGenerator(uint32_t seed = 42) : rng(seed), dist(0.0f, 1.0f) {}\n    val_t rand() { return dist(rng); }\n};\n\n// Generate a random point inside a triangle using barycentric coordinates\nVec3 randomPointInTriangle(const Triangle& t, RandomGenerator& rng) {\n    val_t u = rng.rand();\n    val_t v = rng.rand();\n    if (u + v > 1.0f) {\n        u = 1.0f - u;\n        v = 1.0f - v;\n    }\n    Vec3 ab = t.b - t.a;\n    Vec3 ac = t.c - t.a;\n    return t.a + ab * u + ac * v;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Ray-Triangle Intersection (Möller-Trumbore algorithm)\n// ============================================================================\n\nval_t rayTriangleIntersect(const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir,\n                            const Vec3& v0, const Vec3& v1, const Vec3& v2) {\n    Vec3 e1 = v1 - v0;\n    Vec3 e2 = v2 - v0;\n    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);\n    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);\n\n    if (std::abs(det) < EPSILON) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n\n    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;\n    Vec3 tvec = orig - v0;\n    val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;\n    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n\n    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);\n    val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n\n    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Visibility Testing (Octree-accelerated)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Check if a ray between two triangles is blocked by any other triangle\n// Uses octree for O(log N) instead of O(N) search\nbool isRayBlocked(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,\n                  const Octree& octree,\n                  size_t srcTriIdx, size_t dstTriIdx) {\n    Vec3 dir = to - from;\n    val_t rayLen = dir.norm();\n    if (rayLen < EPSILON) return true;\n    Vec3 dirNorm = dir / rayLen;\n\n    return octree.applyToTris(from, to, [&](size_t idx, const Triangle& tri) {\n        if (idx == srcTriIdx || idx == dstTriIdx) return false;\n\n        val_t dist = rayTriangleIntersect(from, dirNorm, tri.a, tri.b, tri.c);\n        if (dist > EPSILON && dist < rayLen - EPSILON) {\n            return true;  // Ray is blocked\n        }\n        return false;\n    });\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Form Factor Computation (Kij)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Compute the cosine of angle between vector and triangle normal\nval_t cosPhi(const Vec3& v, const Vec3& normal) {\n    val_t vNorm = v.norm();\n    if (vNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;\n    return std::max(ZERO, v.dot(normal) / vNorm);\n}\n\n// Compute form factor Kij between triangle i (receiver) and triangle j (emitter)\nval_t computeKij(size_t idxI, size_t idxJ,\n                  const std::vector<Triangle>& triangles,\n                  const Octree& octree,\n                  RandomGenerator& rng) {\n    const Triangle& triI = triangles[idxI];\n    const Triangle& triJ = triangles[idxJ];\n\n    // Cull triangles facing the same direction\n    if (triI.normal().dot(triJ.normal()) > 0.99f) return ZERO;\n\n    val_t kij = ZERO;\n\n    for (int r = 0; r < NUM_RAYS; ++r) {\n        Vec3 pI = randomPointInTriangle(triI, rng);\n        Vec3 pJ = randomPointInTriangle(triJ, rng);\n\n        if (isRayBlocked(pI, pJ, octree, idxI, idxJ)) continue;\n\n        Vec3 v = pJ - pI;\n        val_t distSqr = v.squaredNorm();\n        if (distSqr < EPSILON) continue;\n\n        val_t cosPhiI = cosPhi(v, triI.normal());\n        val_t cosPhiJ = cosPhi(-v, triJ.normal());\n\n        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;\n\n        kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distSqr);\n    }\n\n    return kij * INV_NUM_RAYS;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Tau (time delay) Computation\n// ============================================================================\n\nint computeTau(const Triangle& triI, const Triangle& triJ) {\n    val_t dist = (triI.center() - triJ.center()).norm();\n    return static_cast<int>(std::ceil(dist * INV_WAVE_SPEED));\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Room Response Simulation State\n// ============================================================================\n\nstruct SimulationState {\n    size_t numTriangles;\n    size_t numTimesteps;\n\n    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n    std::vector<val_t> areas;       // Area of each triangle\n    std::vector<val_t> rho;         // Reflectivity (0.0 to 1.0)\n    std::vector<val_t> kij;         // Form factors (N x N matrix, row-major)\n    std::vector<int> tau;           // Time delays (N x N matrix, row-major)\n    std::vector<val_t> radE;        // Emission radiosity (T x N matrix)\n    std::vector<val_t> radB;        // Reflected radiosity (T x N matrix)\n    std::vector<val_t> distances;   // Computed distances from source\n\n    Octree octree;                  // Spatial acceleration structure\n\n    size_t sourceIndex;\n\n    size_t idx2d(size_t i, size_t j) const { return i * numTriangles + j; }\n    size_t idxTN(size_t t, size_t n) const { return t * numTriangles + n; }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Initialization\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, int subdivisions, size_t timesteps,\n                          size_t sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity) {\n    // Generate mesh\n    IcosphereMesh mesh(subdivisions, 10.0f);  // Radius 10 units\n    state.triangles = std::move(mesh.triangles);\n    state.numTriangles = state.triangles.size();\n    state.numTimesteps = timesteps;\n    state.sourceIndex = sourceIdx % state.numTriangles;\n\n    printf(\"Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\\n\", state.numTriangles);\n\n    // Build octree for spatial acceleration\n    printf(\"Building octree...\\n\");\n    state.octree.build(state.triangles);\n\n    // Initialize areas\n    state.areas.resize(state.numTriangles);\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        state.areas[i] = state.triangles[i].area();\n    }\n\n    // Initialize reflectivity\n    state.rho.resize(state.numTriangles, reflectivity);\n\n    // Initialize matrices\n    state.kij.resize(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n    state.tau.resize(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles, 0);\n    state.radE.resize(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n    state.radB.resize(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n    state.distances.resize(state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n\n    // Set source emission (active for first half of timesteps)\n    size_t timeOn = 0;\n    size_t timeOff = timesteps / 2;\n    for (size_t t = timeOn; t < timeOff; ++t) {\n        state.radE[state.idxTN(t, state.sourceIndex)] = 1.0f;\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Precomputation Phase\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid computeFormFactors(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Computing form factors (Kij)...\\n\");\n    RandomGenerator rng(42);\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n            if (i == j) continue;\n            state.kij[state.idx2d(i, j)] = computeKij(\n                i, j, state.triangles, state.octree, rng);\n        }\n        if ((i + 1) % 100 == 0 || i + 1 == state.numTriangles) {\n            printf(\"  Progress: %zu/%zu triangles\\n\", i + 1, state.numTriangles);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nvoid computeTimeDelays(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Computing time delays (Tau)...\\n\");\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n            if (i == j) continue;\n            state.tau[state.idx2d(i, j)] = computeTau(\n                state.triangles[i], state.triangles[j]);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Simulation Phase (Wave Propagation)\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid runSimulation(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Running wave propagation simulation...\\n\");\n\n    for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n            val_t sumB = ZERO;\n\n            for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n                if (i == j) continue;\n\n                int tauij = state.tau[state.idx2d(i, j)];\n\n                // Skip if wave hasn't yet propagated from j to i\n                if (static_cast<int>(t) < tauij) continue;\n\n                val_t kij = state.kij[state.idx2d(i, j)];\n                if (kij <= ZERO) continue;\n\n                // Get radiosity from source triangle at time when emission occurred\n                size_t srcTime = t - static_cast<size_t>(tauij);\n                val_t radJ = state.radB[state.idxTN(srcTime, j)];\n                if (radJ <= ZERO) continue;\n\n                // Accumulate contribution: form factor * area * source radiosity\n                sumB += std::min(kij * state.areas[j], ONE) * radJ;\n            }\n\n kernel signature and data layout for a chunk of pairs, defining compact structs for triangles (vertices, normal) and octree nodes, with per-thread access patterns arranged for coalesced reads across neighboring j indices.\n\nFor occlusion testing, I'm writing a device function that walks the octree stack-based, intersecting the ray against each leaf's triangle list (skipping the source/destination triangles) and recursing into child nodes whose bounding boxes the ray intersects, returning true as soon as a blocking hit within the ray's length is found.\n\nI'm double-checking that this traversal matches the original CPU recursive logic exactly: the root's own box isn't tested (matching original behavior), children are only descended if their box passes the ray test, and leaves are identified purely by having a nonempty triangle list versus internal nodes having children — so pushing only validated children onto the stack is equivalent to the original's recursive box-then-tris checks.\n\nI'm porting the ray-box slab test using the node's stored center and half-extent, keeping the exact arithmetic order (including the cross-product-style separating axis checks with epsilon) so floating-point results match the original bit-for-bit, and similarly porting the ray-triangle intersection routine unchanged.\n\nThen I'm sizing the per-thread traversal stack by estimating the octree's max depth — starting from the icosphere's bounding box diagonal and halving it each level until nodes become leaves (either by small diagonal or triangle count threshold), to pairs with negligible distance or non-positive cosines. I'll verify that unused host member functions like applyToTris and rayIntersectsBox won't trigger warnings since they're class members.\n\nI'm pruning dead host-side code since point generation now happens on the device: removing isRayBlocked, computeKij, cosPhi, rayTriangleIntersect, computeTau, and randomPointInTriangle, while keeping triangleBoxOverlap since it's still used during tree construction.\n\nI'm keeping the Vec3 host operators needed for mesh creation and the host RandomGenerator used in form factor prep, then planning out the device-side Vec helpers and the DTri struct for converting triangle data into the device representation.\n\nI'll add a fatal helper for errors, a maxDepth guard after flattening the octree, and set up the progress-printing simulation loop with the kernel launches following.\n\n","time":{"start":1792957948489,"end":1792957997178},"metadata":{"anthropic":{"signature":""}}}}
{"type":"text","timestamp":1792957997231,"sessionID":"ses_e8b64bf2bffe0Aaayo04wvl3FR","part":{"id":"prt_1749fe081001JRKlA9bhIZVhvR","messageID":"msg_1749f1e09001RDN5ARdR5WCvuO","sessionID":"ses_e8b64bf2bffe0Aaayo04wvl3FR","type":"text","text":"CMake passes `-x cu` for a `.cpp` marked as CUDA, so I can keep the single `roomsim.cpp` file. I'll write the CUDA version now.\n\nDesign notes that drive the code:\n- **Exact RNG stream:** draws are consumed sequentially by non-culled pairs in row-major order. The host generates them with the same `RandomGenerator` in the same order, in chunks double-buffered against the GPU. Each pair gets its draw offset, so the results stay bit-identical in structure.\n- **Octree:** flattened to device arrays. Whether a ray is blocked is order-independent, so the traversal order does not change results.\n- **Simulation:** each timestep depends only on earlier rows (`tau >= 1` for distinct triangles), so threads parallelize over receivers `i` within a timestep. The `j` summation order is kept.","time":{"start":1792957997185,"end":1792957997207}}}
{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1792958056821,"sessionID":"ses_e8b64bf2bffe0Aaayo04wvl3FR","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"toolu_01XaSyBSnF3GGTMMBiUFs28e","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/roomsim_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_cuda_r1/roomsim/roomsim.cpp","content":"/**\n * Room Response Simulation Benchmark (CUDA)\n * \n * Simulates room impulse response using radiosity-based wave propagation. It\n * models how sound/light waves propagate between surfaces in a room by computing:\n * \n * 1. Form factors (Kij) between all pairs of triangles based on visibility and geometry\n * 2. Wave propagation using radiosity equations with time delays (Tau)\n * 3. Distance estimation via cross-correlation of radiosity values\n * \n * The implementation generates a procedural icosphere mesh to simulate a room.\n *\n * GPU parallelization:\n * - Form factors: one thread per (receiver, emitter) pair. The random sample\n *   stream is consumed in exactly the same order as the sequential reference\n *   (row-major over non-culled pairs), so the generated samples are identical.\n *   The host produces the stream in chunks that are double-buffered against the\n *   GPU, so generation overlaps with kernel execution.\n * - Visibility: the octree is flattened and traversed on the device.\n * - Wave propagation: one thread per receiver triangle for each timestep. Each\n *   timestep only reads radiosity from strictly earlier timesteps (tau >= 1 for\n *   distinct triangles), so the timestep loop is sequential while the receivers\n *   are fully parallel. The per-receiver summation order is preserved.\n * - Cross-correlation: one thread per triangle.\n */\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <array>\n#include <cfloat>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdint>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <map>\n#include <memory>\n#include <random>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Error handling\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Separating axis test for triangle-box overlap\nbool triangleBoxOverlap(const Vec3& boxCenter, const Vec3& boxHalfSize, const Triangle& tri) {\n    // Translate triangle to box center\n    Vec3 v0 = tri.a - boxCenter;\n    Vec3 v1 = tri.b - boxCenter;\n    Vec3 v2 = tri.c - boxCenter;\n\n    // Triangle edges\n    Vec3 e0 = v1 - v0;\n    Vec3 e1 = v2 - v1;\n    Vec3 e2 = v0 - v2;\n\n    // Test box normals (AABB axes)\n    auto minMax3 = [](val_t a, val_t b, val_t c) {\n        return std::make_pair(std::min({a, b, c}), std::max({a, b, c}));\n    };\n\n    auto [minX, maxX] = minMax3(v0.x, v1.x, v2.x);\n    if (minX > boxHalfSize.x || maxX < -boxHalfSize.x) return false;\n\n    auto [minY, maxY] = minMax3(v0.y, v1.y, v2.y);\n    if (minY > boxHalfSize.y || maxY < -boxHalfSize.y) return false;\n\n    auto [minZ, maxZ] = minMax3(v0.z, v1.z, v2.z);\n    if (minZ > boxHalfSize.z || maxZ < -boxHalfSize.z) return false;\n\n    // Test triangle normal\n    Vec3 triNormal = e0.cross(e1);\n    val_t d = triNormal.dot(v0);\n    val_t r = boxHalfSize.x * std::abs(triNormal.x) +\n              boxHalfSize.y * std::abs(triNormal.y) +\n              boxHalfSize.z * std::abs(triNormal.z);\n    if (std::abs(d) > r) return false;\n\n    // Test 9 edge cross products\n    auto testAxis = [&](const Vec3& axis) {\n        val_t p0 = axis.dot(v0);\n        val_t p1 = axis.dot(v1);\n        val_t p2 = axis.dot(v2);\n        val_t r = boxHalfSize.x * std::abs(axis.x) +\n                  boxHalfSize.y * std::abs(axis.y) +\n                  boxHalfSize.z * std::abs(axis.z);\n        auto [minP, maxP] = minMax3(p0, p1, p2);\n        return !(minP > r || maxP < -r);\n    };\n\n    Vec3 axes[3] = {{1,0,0}, {0,1,0}, {0,0,1}};\n    Vec3 edges[3] = {e0, e1, e2};\n    for (const auto& axis : axes) {\n        for (const auto& edge : edges) {\n            Vec3 crossAxis = axis.cross(edge);\n            if (crossAxis.squaredNorm() > EPSILON) {\n                if (!testAxis(crossAxis)) return false;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n\nconstexpr size_t MAX_OCTREE_TRIS = 8;\nconstexpr val_t MAX_OCTREE_LEAF_SIZE = 0.5f;\n\nclass Octree {\npublic:\n    Vec3 minBound, maxBound;\n    Vec3 halfExtent, center;\n    std::unique_ptr<Octree> children[8];\n    std::vector<size_t> triangleIndices;  // Indices into the global triangle list\n    const std::vector<Triangle>* allTriangles;  // Pointer to all triangles\n\n    Octree() : allTriangles(nullptr) {}\n\n    void build(const std::vector<Triangle>& triangles) {\n        allTriangles = &triangles;\n        if (triangles.empty()) return;\n\n        // Compute bounding box\n        minBound = triangles[0].a;\n        maxBound = triangles[0].a;\n        for (const auto& tri : triangles) {\n            for (const auto* v : {&tri.a, &tri.b, &tri.c}) {\n                minBound.x = std::min(minBound.x, v->x);\n                minBound.y = std::min(minBound.y, v->y);\n                minBound.z = std::min(minBound.z, v->z);\n                maxBound.x = std::max(maxBound.x, v->x);\n                maxBound.y = std::max(maxBound.y, v->y);\n                maxBound.z = std::max(maxBound.z, v->z);\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Collect all indices\n        std::vector<size_t> allIndices(triangles.size());\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < triangles.size(); small, make this a leaf\n        if (indices.size() <= MAX_OCTREE_TRIS ||\n            (maxBound - minBound).norm() < MAX_OCTREE_LEAF_SIZE) {\n            triangleIndices = indices;\n            return;\n        }\n\n        // Subdivide into 8 children\n        Vec3 childHalfSize = halfExtent * 0.5f;\n        std::vector<size_t> childIndices[8];\n\n        for (size_t idx : indices) {\n            const Triangle& tri = (*allTriangles)[idx];\n\n            // Check which children this triangle overlaps\n            for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n                Vec3 childCenter = center;\n                childCenter.x += (i & 1) ? childHalfSize.x : -childHalfSize.x;\n                childCenter.y += (i & 2) ? childHalfSize.y : -childHalfSize.y;\n                childCenter.z += (i & 4) ? childHalfSize.z : -childHalfSize.z;\n\n                if (triangleBoxOverlap(childCenter, childHalfSize, tri)) {\n                    childIndices[i].push_back(idx);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Check if we can't split further (all triangles in one child)\n        bool canSplit = false;\n        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n            if (!childIndices[i].empty() && childIndices[i].size() < indices.size()) {\n                canSplit = true;\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (!canSplit) {\n            triangleIndices = indices;\n            return;\n        }\n\n        // Build children\n        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n            if (!childIndices[i].empty()) {\n                Vec3 childMin = center;\n                Vec3 childMax = center;\n                childMin.x = (i & 1) ? center.x : minBound.x;\n                childMax.x = (i & 1) ? maxBound.x : center.x;\n                childMin.y = (i & 2) ? center.y : minBound.y;\n                childMax.y = (i & 2) ? maxBound.y : center.y;\n                childMin.z = (i & 4) ? center.z : minBound.z;\n                childMax.z = (i & 4) ? maxBound.z : center.z;\n\n                children[i] = std::make_unique<Octree>();\n                children[i]->allTriangles = allTriangles;\n                children[i]->buildNode(childIndices[i], childMin, ============================================================================\n\n// Generate an icosphere by subdividing an icosahedron\nclass IcosphereMesh {\npublic:\n    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n\n    IcosphereMesh(int subdivisions, val_t radius) {\n        // Initial icosahedron vertices\n        const val_t t = (1.0f + std::sqrt(5.0f)) / 2.0f;\n\n        std::vector<Vec3> vertices = {\n            Vec3(-1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0, -1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0,  1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0, -1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0,  1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius\n        };\n\n        // Initial icosahedron faces (20 triangles)\n        std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> faces = {\n            {0, 11, 5}, {0, 5, 1}, {0, 1, 7}, {0, 7, 10}, {0, 10, 11},\n            {1, 5, 9}, {5, 11, 4}, {11, 10, 2}, {10, 7, 6}, {7, 1, 8},\n            {3, 9, 4}, {3, 4, 2}, {3, 2, 6}, {3, 6, 8}, {3, 8, 9},\n            {4, 9, 5}, {2, 4, 11}, {6, 2, 10}, {8, 6, 7}, {9, 8, 1}\n        };\n\n        // Subdivide\n        for (int i = 0; i < subdivisions; ++i) {\n            std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> newFaces;\n            std::map<std::pair<idx_t, idx_t>, idx_t> midpointCache;\n\n            auto getMidpoint = [&](idx_t i1, idx_t i2) -> idx_t {\n                auto key = std::make_pair(std::min(i1, i2), std::max(i1, i2));\n                auto it = midpointCache.find(key);\n                if (it != midpointCache.end()) return it->second;\n\n                Vec3 mid = (vertices[i1] + vertices[i2]) / 2.0f;\n                mid = mid.normalized() * radius;\n                idx_t idx = static_cast<idx_t>(vertices.size());\n                vertices.push_back(mid);\n                midpointCache[key] = idx;\n                return idx;\n            };\n\n            for (const auto& face : faces) {\n                idx_t a = getMidpoint(face[0], face[1]);\n                idx_t b = getMidpoint(face[1], face[2]);\n                idx_t c = getMidpoint(face[2], face[0]);\n\n                newFaces.push_back({face[0], a, c});\n                newFaces.push_back({face[1], b, a});\n                newFaces.push_back({face[2], c, b});\n                newFaces.push_back({a, b, c});\n            }\n            faces = std::move(newFaces);\n        }\n\n        // Build triangles (normals pointing inward for a \"room\")\n        triangles.reserve(faces.size());\n        for (const auto& face : faces) {\n            // Reverse winding to make normals point inward\n            triangles.emplace_back(vertices[face[2]], vertices[face[1]], vertices[face[0]]);\n        }\n    }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Random ============================================================================\n// Device data layout\n// ============================================================================\n\nstruct DVec3 {\n Leaves have triCount > 0.\nstruct DNode {\n    DVec3 center;\n    DVec3 half;\n    int32_t child[8];\n    uint32_t triBegin;\n    uint32_t triCount;\n};\n\nstatic DVec3 toDVec3(const Vec3& v) { return DVec3{v.x, v.y, v.z}; }\n\n__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ DVec3 dadd(DVec3 a, DVec3 b) { return {a.x + b.x, a.y + b.y, a.z + b.z}; }\n__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ DVec3 dsub(DVec3 a, DVec3 b) { return {a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y, a.z - b.z}; }\n__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ DVec3 dmul(DVec3 a, float s) { return {a.x * s, a.y * s, a.z * s}; }\n__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ DVec3 ddiv(DVec3 a, float s) { return {a.x / s, a.y / s, a.z / s}; }\n__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ DVec3 dneg(DVec3 a) { return {-a.x, -a.y, -a.z}; }\n__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ float ddot(DVec3 a, DVec3 b) { return a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z; }\n__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ DVec3 dcross(DVec3 a, DVec3 b) {\n    return {a.y * b.z - a.z * b.y, a.z * b.x - a.x * b.z, a.x * b.y - a.y * b.x};\n}\n__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ float dsqnorm(DVec3 a) { return a.x * a.x + a.y * a.y + a.z * a.z; }\n__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ float dnorm(DVec3 a) { return sqrtf(dsqnorm(a)); }\n\n// Point inside a triangle from barycentric-style samples (same expression order as host)\n__device__ __forceinline__ DVec3 dPointInTriangle(const DTri& t, float u, float v) {\n    DVec3 ab = dsub(t.b, t.a);\n    DVec3 ac = dsub(t.c, t.a);\n    return dadd(dadd(t.a, dmul(ab, u)), dmul(ac, v));\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Device geometry: ray-box and ray-triangle tests\n// ============================================================================\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ bool dRayIntersectsBox(const DNode& nd, DVec3 p1, DVec3 p2) {\n    DVec3 d = dmul(dsub(p2, p1), 0.5f);\n    DVec3 c = dsub(dadd(p1, d), nd.center);\n    DVec3 ad = {fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z)};\n    const DVec3& he = nd.half;\n\n    if (fabsf(c.x) > he.x + ad.x) return false;\n    if (fabsf(c.y) > he.y + ad.y) return false;\n    if (fabsf(c.z) > he.z + ad.z) return false;\n\n    if (fabsf(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) > he.y * ad.z + he.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;\n    if (fabsf(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) > he.z * ad.x + he.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;\n    if (fabsf(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) > he.x * ad.y + he.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;\n\n    return true;\n}\n\n// Moller-Trumbore ray-triangle intersection. Returns FLT_MAX on miss.\n__device__ __forceinline__ float dRayTriangleIntersect(DVec3 orig, DVec3 dir,\n                                                       DVec3 v0, DVec3 v1, DVec3 v2) {\n    DVec3 e1 = dsub(v1, v0);\n    DVec3 e2 = dsub(v2, v0);\n    DVec3 pvec = dcross(dir, e2);\n    float det = ddot(e1, pvec);\n\n    if (fabsf(det) < EPSILON) return FLT_MAX;\n\n    float invDet = 1.0f / det;\n    DVec3 tvec = dsub(orig, v0);\n    float u = ddot(tvec, pvec) * invDet;\n    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return FLT_MAX;\n\n    DVec3 qvec = dcross(tvec, e1);\n    float v = ddot(dir, qvec) * invDet;\n    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return FLT_MAX;\n\n    return ddot(e2, qvec) * invDet;\n}\n\n// Check if the segment from -> to is blocked by any triangle other than src/dst.\n// Octree traversal: the result is a pure \"any blocker\" predicate, so traversal\n// order does not affect the outcome.\n__device__ bool dIsRayBlocked(DVec3 from, DVec3 to,\n                              const DTri* __restrict__ tris,\n                              const DNode* __restrict__ nodes,\n                              const uint32_t* __restrict__ triList,\n                              uint32_t srcIdx, uint32_t dstIdx) {\n    DVec3 dir = dsub(to, from);\n    float rayLen = dnorm(dir);\n    if (rayLen < EPSILON) return true;\n    DVec3 dirNorm = ddiv(dir, rayLen);\n\n    int stack[TRAVERSAL_STACK];\n    int sp = 0;\n    stack[sp++] = 0;  // Root (its box is not tested, matching the host traversal)\n\n    while (sp > 0) {\n        const DNode& nd = nodes[stack[--sp]];\n        if (nd.triCount > 0) {\n            for (uint32_t q = 0; q < nd.triCount; ++q) {\n                const uint32_t idx = triList[nd.triBegin + q];\n                if (idx == srcIdx || idx == dstIdx) continue;\n                const DTri& t = tris[idx];\n                float dist = dRayTriangleIntersect(from, dirNorm, t.a, t.b, t.c);\n                if (dist > EPSILON && dist < rayLen - EPSILON) return true;\n            }\n        } else {\n            for (int c = 0; c < 8; ++c) {\n                const int ch = nd.child[c];\n                if (ch >= 0 && dRayIntersectsBox(nodes[ch], from, to)) {\n                    stack[sp++] = ch;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return false;\n}\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ float dCosPhi(DVec3 v, DVec3 normal) {\n    float vNorm = dnorm(v);\n    if (vNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;\n    float c = ddot(v, normal) / vNorm;\n    return (ZERO < c) ? c : ZERO;  // matches std::max(ZERO, c)\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Simulation state (host side)\n// ============================================================================\n\nstruct SimulationState {\n    size_t numTriangles;\n    size_t numTimesteps;\n\n    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n only\n    std::vector<val_t> distances;   // Computed distances from source\n\n    Octree octree;                  // Host-side build of the spatial acceleration structure\n\n    size_t sourceIndex;\n\n    size_t idx2d(size_t i, size_t j) const { return i * numTriangles + j; }\n    size_t idxTN(size_t t, size_t n) const { return t * numTriangles + n; }\n};\n\n// Device-side buffers\nstruct DeviceState {\n    DTri* tris = nullptr;\n    DVec3* centers = nullptr;\n    float* areas = nullptr;\n    float* rho = nullptr;\n    float* radE = nullptr;\n    float* radB = // N x N transposed, wT[j*N + i] = min(kij[i][j] * area[j], 1) or 0\n    float* distances = nullptr;\n    DNode* nodes = nullptr;\n    uint32_t* triList = nullptr;\n    // Double-buffered per-chunk random samples and draw offsets\n    float* chunkDraws[2] = {nullptr, nullptr};\n    uint32_t* chunkOffs[2] = {nullptr, nullptr};\n};\n\ntemplate <typename T>\nstatic T* deviceAlloc(size_t count) {\n timesteps, size_t sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity) {\n    // Generate mesh\n    IcosphereMesh mesh(subdivisions, 10.0f);  // Radius 10 units\n    state.triangles = std::move(mesh.triangles);\n    state.numTriangles = state.triangles.size();\n    state.numTimesteps = timesteps;\n    state.sourceIndex = sourceIdx % state.numTriangles;\n\n    printf(\"Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\\n\", state.numTriangles);\n\n    // Build octree for spatial acceleration\n    printf(\"Building octree...\\n\");\n    state.octree.build(state.triangles);\n\n    // Initialize areas\n    state.areas.resize(state.numTriangles);\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        state.areas[i] = state.triangles[i].area();\n    }\n\n    // Initialize reflectivity\n    state.rho.assign(state.numTriangles, reflectivity);\n\n    // Source emission (active for first half of timesteps)\n    state.radE.assign(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n    size_t timeOn = 0;\n    size_t timeOff = timesteps / 2;\n    for (size_t t = timeOn; t < timeOff; ++t) {\n        state.radE[state.idxTN(t, state.sourceIndex)] = 1.0f;\n    }\n\n    // ---- Device allocation and upload ----\n    const size_t n = state.numTriangles;\n    const size_t T = timesteps;\n\n    FlatOctree flat;\n    flattenOctree(state.octree, flat, 0);\n    if (flat.maxDepth > MAX_OCTREE_DEPTH) fatal(\"octree deeper than device traversal stack supports\");\n\n    std::vector<DTri> hostTris(n);\n    std::vector<DVec3> hostCenters(n);\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        const Triangle& t = state.triangles[i];\n        hostTris[i] = DTri{toDVec3(t.a), toDVec3(t.b), toDVec3(t.c), toDVec3(t.normal())};\n        hostCenters[i] = toDVec3(t.center());\n    }\n\n    dev.tris = deviceAlloc<DTri>(n);\n    dev.centers = deviceAlloc<DVec3>(n);\n    dev.areas = deviceAlloc<float>(n);\n    dev.rho = deviceAlloc<float>(n);\n    dev.radE = deviceAlloc<float>(T * n);\n    dev.radB = deviceAlloc<float>(T * n);\n    dev.kij = deviceAlloc<float>(n * n);\n    dev.tauT = deviceAlloc<int>(n * n);\n    dev.wT = deviceAlloc<float>(n * n);\n    dev.distances = deviceAlloc<float>(n);\n    dev.nodes = deviceAlloc<DNode>(flat.nodes.size());\n    dev.triList = deviceAlloc<uint32_t>(flat.triList.size());\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dev.tris, hostTris.data(), n * sizeof(DTri), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dev.centers, hostCenters.data(), n * sizeof(DVec3), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dev.areas, state.areas.data(), n * sizeof(float), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dev.rho, state.rho.data(), n * sizeof(float), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dev.radE, state.radE.data(), T * n * sizeof(float), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(dev.radB, 0, T * n * sizeof(float)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(dev.kij, 0, n * n * sizeof(float)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(dev.tauT, 0, n * n * sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(dev.wT, 0, n * n * sizeof(float)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(dev.distances, 0, n * sizeof(float)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dev.nodes, flat.nodes.data(), flat.nodes.size() * sizeof(DNode), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    if (!flat.triList.empty()) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dev.triList, flat.triList.data(), flat.triList.size() * sizeof(uint32_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    }\n\n    // Host-side result buffers are only materialized when validation needs them\n    state.distances.assign(n, ZERO);\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Form factor kernels\n// ============================================================================\n\n// One thread per (receiver i, emitter j) pair in a chunk of rows.\n// offs[k] is the offset into `draws` of this pair's 64 random numbers, or SKIP_PAIR.\n__global__ void formFactorKernel(size_t n, size_t i0, size_t numPairs,\n                                 const uint32_t* __restrict__ offs,\n                                 const float* __restrict__ draws,\n                                 const DTri* __restrict__ tris,\n                                 const DNode* __restrict__ nodes,\n                                 const uint32_t* __restrict__ triList,\n                                 float* __restrict__ kij) {\n    const size_t k = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (k >= numPairs) return;\n\n    const size_t i = i0 + k / n;\n    const size_t j = k % n;\n    float* out = kij + i * n + j;\n\n    const uint32_t off = offs[k];\n    if (off == SKIP_PAIR) {\n        *out = ZERO;\n        return;\n    }\n\n    const DTri ti = tris[i];\n    const DTri tj = tris[j];\n    const float* R = draws + off;\n\n    float kacc = ZERO;\n    for (int r = 0; r < NUM_RAYS; ++r) {\n        float u = R[0];\n        float v = R[1];\n        if (u + v > ONE) {\n            u = ONE - u;\n            v = ONE - v;\n        }\n        const DVec3 pI = dPointInTriangle(ti, u, v);\n\n        u = R[2];\n        v = R[3];\n        if (u + v > ONE) {\n            u = ONE - u;\n            v = ONE - v;\n        }\n        const DVec3 pJ = dPointInTriangle(tj, u, v);\n        R += 4;\n\n        if (dIsRayBlocked(pI, pJ, tris, nodes, triList,\n                          static_cast<uint32_t>(i), static_cast<uint32_t>(j))) continue;\n\n        const DVec3 vec = dsub(pJ, pI);\n        const float distSqr = dsqnorm(vec);\n        if (distSqr < EPSILON) continue;\n\n        const float cosI = dCosPhi(vec, ti.n);\n        const float cosJ = dCosPhi(dneg(vec), tj.n);\n        if (cosI <= ZERO || cosJ <= ZERO) continue;\n\n        kacc += (cosI * cosJ) / (PI * distSqr);\n    }\n\n    *out = kacc * INV_NUM_RAYS;\n}\n\n// Time delay for all pairs, stored transposed: tauT[j*n + i]\n__global__ void timeDelayKernel(size_t n, const DVec3* __restrict__ centers, int* __restrict__ tauT) {\n    const size_t k = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (k >= n * n) return;\n    const size_t i = k / n;\n    const size_t j = k % n;\n\n    int tau = 0;\n    if (i != j) {\n        const float dist = dnorm(dsub(centers[i], centers[j]));\n        tau = static_cast<int>(ceilf(dist * INV_WAVE_SPEED));\n    }\n    tauT[j * n + i] = tau;\n}\n\n// Propagation weights, stored transposed (indexed by emitter j, then receiver i):\n// wT[j*n + i] = min(kij[i][j] * area[j], 1) when kij > 0, else 0.\n__global__ void weightKernel(size_t n, const float* __restrict__ kij,\n                             const float* __restrict__ areas, float* __restrict__ wT) {\n    const size_t k = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (k >= n * n) return;\n    const size_t i = k / n;\n    const size_t j = k % n;\n\n    float w = ZERO;\n    if (i != j) {\n        const float kv = kij[i * n + j];\n        if (kv > ZERO) {\n            const float p = kv * areas[j];\n            w = (ONE < p) ? ONE : p;  // matches std::min(p, ONE)\n        }\n    }\n    wT[j * n + i] = w;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Precomputation Phase\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid computeTimeDelays(SimulationState& state, DeviceState& dev) {\n    printf(\"Computing time delays (Tau)...\\n\");\n    const size_t n = state.numTriangles;\n    const size_t total = n * n;\n    const unsigned blocks = static_cast<unsigned>((total + THREADS_PER_BLOCK - 1) / THREADS_PER_BLOCK);\n    timeDelayKernel<<<blocks, THREADS_PER_BLOCK>>>(n, dev.centers, dev.tauT);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n}\n\nvoid computeFormFactors(SimulationState& state, DeviceState& dev) {\n    printf(\"Computing form factors (Kij)...\\n\");\n    const size_t n = state.numTriangles;\n    RandomGenerator rng(42);\n\n    // Rows per chunk: bounded so that staging buffers stay modest in size\n    const size_t rowsPerChunk = std::max<size_t>(1, std::min(n, MAX_PAIRS_PER_CHUNK / n));\n    const size_t maxPairs = rowsPerChunk * n;\n    const size_t maxDraws = maxPairs * DRAWS_PER_PAIR;\n\n    float* hostDraws[2] = {nullptr, nullptr};\n    uint32_t* hostOffs[2] = {nullptr, nullptr};\n    cudaStream_t streams[2] = {nullptr, nullptr};\n    cudaEvent_t done[2] = {nullptr, nullptr};\n    bool inFlight[2] = {false, false};\n\n    for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&hostDraws[b]), maxDraws * sizeof(float)));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&hostOffs[b]), maxPairs * sizeof(uint32_t)));\n        dev.chunkDraws[b] = deviceAlloc<float>(maxDraws);\n        dev.chunkOffs[b] = deviceAlloc<uint32_t>(maxPairs);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&streams[b], cudaStreamNonBlocking));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&done[b], cudaEventDisableTiming));\n    }\n\n    size_t chunk = 0;\n    for (size_t i0 = 0; i0 < n; i0 += rowsPerChunk, ++chunk) {\n        const size_t i1 = std::min(n, i0 + rowsPerChunk);\n        const size_t pairs = (i1 - i0) * n;\n        const int b = static_cast<int>(chunk & 1);\n\n        // Wait until the previous kernel that used this staging buffer has finished\n        if (inFlight[b]) {\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventSynchronize(done[b]));\n            inFlight[b] = false;\n        }\n\n        // Host: generate draws in the exact order of the sequential reference.\n        // Pairs with i == j or culled by the normal test consume no draws.\n        uint32_t* offs = hostOffs[b];\n        float* draws = hostDraws[b];\n        size_t cursor = 0;\n        for (size_t i = i0; i < i1; ++i) {\n            const Triangle& triI = state.triangles[i];\n            for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n                const size_t k = (i - i0) * n + j;\n                if (i == j || triI.normal().dot(state.triangles[j].normal()) > 0.99f) {\n                    offs[k] = SKIP_PAIR;\n                    continue;\n                }\n                offs[k] = static_cast<uint32_t>(cursor);\n                for (int q = 0; q < DRAWS_PER_PAIR; ++q) {\n                    draws[cursor++] = rng.rand();\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (cursor > 0) {\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(dev.chunkDraws[b], draws, cursor * sizeof(float),\n                                       cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, streams[b]));\n        }\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(dev.chunkOffs[b], offs, pairs * sizeof(uint32_t),\n                                   cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, streams[b]));\n\n        const unsigned blocks = static_cast<unsigned>((pairs + THREADS_PER_BLOCK - 1) / THREADS_PER_BLOCK);\n        formFactorKernel<<<blocks, THREADS_PER_BLOCK, 0, streams[b]>>>(\n            n, i0, pairs, dev.chunkOffs[b], dev.chunkDraws[b],\n            dev.tris, dev.nodes, dev.triList, dev.kij);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(done[b], streams[b]));\n        inFlight[b] = true;\n\n        for (size_t i = i0; i < i1; ++i) {\n            if ((i + 1) % 100 == 0 || i + 1 == n) {\n                printf(\"  Progress: %zu/%zu triangles\\n\", i + 1, n);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(streams[b]));\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n\n    // Derive propagation weights and transposed layout from the form factors\n    const size_t total = n * n;\n    const unsigned blocks = static_cast<unsigned>((total + THREADS_PER_BLOCK - 1) / THREADS_PER_BLOCK);\n    weightKernel<<<blocks, THREADS_PER_BLOCK>>>(n, dev.kij, dev.areas, dev.wT);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n\n    for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventDestroy(done[b]));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamDestroy(streams[b]));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(hostDraws[b]));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(hostOffs[b]));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dev.chunkDraws[b]));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dev.chunkOffs[b]));\n        dev.chunkDraws[b] = nullptr;\n        dev.chunkOffs[b] = nullptr;\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Simulation Phase (Wave Propagation)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// One receiver per thread for a single timestep t. Reads only rows < t.\n__global__ void simulationStepKernel(size_t n, size_t t,\n                                     const float* __restrict__ wT,\n                                     const int* __restrict__ tauT,\n                                     const float* __restrict__ rho,\n                                     const float* __restrict__ radE,\n                                     float* __restrict__ radB) {\n    const size_t i = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (i >= n) return;\n\n    float sumB = ZERO;\n    for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n        if (j == i) continue;\n\n        const size_t p = j * n + i;\n        const int tauij = tauT[p];\n\n        // Skip if wave hasn't yet propagated from j to i\n        if (static_cast<int>(t) < tauij) continue;\n\n        const float w = wT[p];\n        if (w <= ZERO) continue;\n\n        // Radiosity from the source triangle at the time emission occurred\n        const size_t srcTime = t - static_cast<size_t>(tauij);\n        const float radJ = radB[srcTime * n + j];\n        if (radJ <= ZERO) continue;\n\n        sumB += w * radJ;\n    }\n\n    radB[t * n + i] = rho[i] * sumB + radE[t * n + i];\n}\n\nvoid runSimulation(SimulationState& state, DeviceState& dev) {\n    printf(\"Running wave propagation simulation...\\n\");\n    const size_t n = state.numTriangles;\n    const size_t T = state.numTimesteps;\n    const unsigned blocks = static_cast<unsigned>((n + THREADS_PER_BLOCK - 1) / THREADS_PER_BLOCK);\n\n    for (size_t t = 0; t < T; ++t) {\n        simulationStepKernel<<<blocks, THREADS_PER_BLOCK>>>(\n            n, t, dev.wT, dev.tauT, dev.rho, dev.radE, dev.radB);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n\n        if ((t + 1) % 10 == 0 || t + 1 == T) {\n            printf(\"  Timestep %zu/%zu\\n\", t + 1, T);\n        }\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Distance Computation (Cross-Correlation)\n// ============================================================================\n\n__global__ void distanceKernel(size_t n, size_t T, size_t src,\n                               const float* __restrict__ radB,\n                               float* __restrict__ distances) {\n    const size_t i = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (i >= n) return;\n\n    float maxCorr = ZERO;\n    int bestT = 0;\n\n    // Discrete cross-correlation to find time delay\n    for (size_t t = 0; t < T; ++t) {\n        float sum = ZERO;\n        for (size_t tt = t; tt < T; ++tt) {\n            const float pB = radB[tt * n + i];\n            const float pS = radB[(tt - t) * n + src];\n            sum += pS * pB;\n        }\n\n        if (sum > maxCorr) {\n            maxCorr = sum;\n            bestT = static_cast<int>(t);\n        }\n    }\n\n    distances[i] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestT);\n}\n\nvoid computeDistances(SimulationState& state, DeviceState& dev) {\n    printf(\"Computing distances via cross-correlation...\\n\");\n    const size_t n = state.numTriangles;\n    const size_t T = state.numTimesteps;\n    const unsigned blocks = static_cast<unsigned>((n + THREADS_PER_BLOCK - 1) / THREADS_PER_BLOCK);\n\n    distanceKernel<<<blocks, THREADS_PER_BLOCK>>>(n, T, state.sourceIndex, dev.radB, dev.distances);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.distances.data(), dev.distances, n * sizeof(float), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n}\n\n// Copy full matrices back to the host, only needed for validation\nvoid downloadForValidation(SimulationState& state, const DeviceState& dev) {\n    const size_t n = state.numTriangles;\n    const size_t T = state.numTimesteps;\n\n    state.kij.assign(n * n, ZERO);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.kij.data(), dev.kij, n * n * sizeof(float), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n\n    state.radB.assign(T * n, ZERO);\n    if (T * n > 0) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.radB.data(), dev.radB, T * n * sizeof(float), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n    }\n}\n\nvoid freeDeviceState(DeviceState& dev) {\n    cudaFree(dev.tris);\n    cudaFree(dev.centers);\n    cudaFree(dev.areas);\n    cudaFree(dev.rho);\n    cudaFree(dev.radE);\n    cudaFree(dev.radB);\n    cudaFree(dev.kij);\n    cudaFree(dev.tauT);\n    cudaFree(dev.wT);\n    cudaFree(dev.distances);\n    cudaFree(dev.nodes);\n    cudaFree(dev.triList);\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Validation\n// ============================================================================\n\nbool validateResults(const SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"\\nValidation:\\n\");\n\n    // Check that distances are non-negative\n    bool allNonNegative = true;\n    val_t minDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n    val_t maxDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::lowest();\n    val_t sumDist = ZERO;\n    int nonZeroCount = 0;\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        val_t d = state.distances[i];\n        if (d < 0) {\n            allNonNegative = false;\n            printf(\"  ERROR: Negative distance at triangle %zu: %f\\n\", i, d);\n        }\n        if (!std::isfinite(d)) {\n            printf(\"  ERROR: Non-finite distance at triangle %zu: %f\\n\", i, d);\n            return false;\n        }\n        minDist = std::min(minDist, d);\n        maxDist = std::max(maxDist, d);\n        sumDist += d;\n        if (d > EPSILON) nonZeroCount++;\n    }\n\n    printf(\"  Distance range: [%.4f, %.4f]\\n\", minDist, maxDist);\n    printf(\"  Average distance: %.4f\\n\", sumDist / static_cast<val_t>(state.numTriangles));\n    printf(\"  Non-zero distances: %d/%zu\\n\", nonZeroCount, state.numTriangles);\n\n    // Check source distance is zero or very small\n    val_t srcDist = state.distances[state.sourceIndex];\n    if (srcDist > WAVE_SPEED * 2) {\n        printf(\"  WARNING: Source triangle distance is non-zero: %.4f\\n\", srcDist);\n    }\n\n    // Check radiosity propagation (some triangles should have received energy)\n    int receivedEnergy = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n            if (state.radB[state.idxTN(t, i)] > EPSILON) {\n                receivedEnergy++;\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    printf(\"  Triangles receiving energy: %d/%zu\\n\", receivedEnergy, state.numTriangles);\n\n    if (receivedEnergy == 0) {\n        printf(\"  ERROR: No triangles received energy - simulation failed\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    // Check Kij matrix (should have some non-zero entries)\n    int nonZeroKij = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        if (state.kij[i] > EPSILON) nonZeroKij++;\n    }\n    printf(\"  Non-zero form factors: %d/%zu (%.2f%%)\\n\",\n           nonZeroKij, state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles,\n           100.0f * nonZeroKij / static_cast<val_t>(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles));\n\n    if (nonZeroKij == 0) {\n        printf(\"  ERROR: All form factors are zero - visibility computation failed\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    if (!allNonNegative) {\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    printf(\"  Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n    return true;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Hash for Verification\n// ============================================================================\n\nuint64_t computeHash(const SimulationState& state) {\n    uint64_t hash = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        const uint32_t* ptr = reinterpret_cast<const uint32_t*>(&state.distances[i]);\n        hash ^= (static_cast<uint64_t>(*ptr) + i) * 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;\n    }\n    return hash;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Helper: Compute subdivision level from target triangle count\n// ============================================================================\n\nint getSubdivisionsForTriangleCount(int targetTriangles) {\n    // Icosphere: 20 triangles initially, 4x per subdivision\n    // subdivisions: 0->20, 1->80, 2->320, 3->1280, 4->5120, 5->20480\n    int subdivisions = 0;\n    int triangles = 20;\n    while (triangles < targetTriangles && subdivisions < 6) {\n        subdivisions++;\n        triangles *= 4;\n    }\n    return subdivisions;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Main\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Target number of triangles (default: 320)\\n\");\n    printf(\"               Actual count will be rounded to nearest icosphere level:\\n\");\n    printf(\"               20, 80, 320, 1280, 5120, 20480\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -t <num>     Number of timesteps (default: 50)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -s <num>     Source triangle index (default: 0)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r <val>     Reflectivity 0.0-1.0 (default: 0.8)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -o           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    int targetTriangles = 320;\n    int timesteps = 50;\n    int sourceIdx = 0;\n    val_t reflectivity = 0.8f;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            targetTriangles = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-t\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            timesteps = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-s\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            sourceIdx = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            reflectivity = static_cast<val_t>(atof(argv[++i]));\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-o\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    int subdivisions = getSubdivisionsForTriangleCount(targetTriangles);\n\n    printf(\"Room Response Simulation Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"===================================\\n\");\n    printf(\"Target triangles: %d (using %d subdivisions)\\n\", targetTriangles, subdivisions);\n    printf(\"Timesteps: %d\\n\", timesteps);\n    printf(\"Source triangle: %d\\n\", sourceIdx);\n    printf(\"Reflectivity: %.2f\\n\", reflectivity);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n The likely culprit is a fixed-size local stack array (stack[128]) used for octree traversal, which could be spilling to slow local memory rather than staying in registers, hurting occupancy and throughput.\n\nTrying to account for the measured 1.76s runtime, I estimate host prep (cull + fill) takes about 1.15s versus roughly 1.0s on the GPU, so with proper overlap total should be closer to 1.2s plus a final chunk — yet it's higher than that, suggesting something isn't overlapping as expected. I suspect the pinned memory allocations (cudaMallocHost of 128MB buffers) are happening inside the timed precompute/compute call itself, inflating the measured time rather than being amortized outside the loop.\n\n","time":{"start":1792958242759,"end":1792958250386},"metadata":{"anthropic":{"signature":""}}}}
